reason: Operator acceptance at the five-round threshold (2026-10-04): the remaining finding is a check-then-unlink race in the log sweep that needs another process of the same user to replace log/files with a symlink between the check and the unlink; ADR-0014 decision 8 states the process log does not protect against a process running as the same user. Hardening through directory descriptors is deferred to the journal and local-state integrity work.
